rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable to this release workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already provided by setup-node@v4 with cache: npm in both release jobs, and adding an equivalent cache is contraindicated. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative successful-duration history (ci_history shows no completed runs) and a short fixed timeout is unsuitable for marketplace publishing. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a release/deployment workflow. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, and P-LIT-SELECT require matrix or test jobs, which this workflow does not have. P-LIT-BAZEL-* patterns require a Bazel build, but this workflow uses npm/vsce. Schedule-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) do not apply because there is no schedule trigger. No evidence supports configuration smells, unused outputs, or distributed cache infrastructure in this repository.
